steps.text: Go to Shadowthorn, the elf town in the swamp south-east of Venore.
steps.source: First, you need to make your way to Shadowthorn in the swamps south-east of Venore.

steps.text: Go east to the big tower and climb it (first floor: elf scouts and an elf).
steps.source: Head east to the large tower and start going up. First floor: 3 Elf Scouts and 1 Elf.

steps.text: Up again (elf scouts, an elf arcanist).
steps.source: Second floor: 4 Elf Scouts and 2 Elf Arcanists.

steps.text: Up again: the 2 dragons here can't reach you.
steps.source: Third floor: 2 Dragons (only accessible from above, they cannot reach you).
Fourth floor: 6 Elf Scouts and 3 Elf Arcanists.

steps.text: Up to the top (elf scouts, elf arcanists).
steps.source: Fifth floor: 3 Elf Scouts and 2 Elf Arcanists.

steps.text: In the box: 30 burst arrows and 60 poison arrows.
steps.source: The rewards will be in two boxes in the last floor.

steps.text: In the other box: a bow and 2 small sapphires.
steps.source: The rewards will be in two boxes in the last floor.
